roles.description: What they may do. None is a member.

shared.description: In a private repository's space only: the repository was shared with them on its own as well, so they stay in its space once out of the organization.

joinedAt.description: When the organization took them in, after they wrote their acceptance record: a acceptance record counts only once this is set.

expiresAt.description: When the invitation lapses, if not taken up first: 7 days after invitedAt when absent.

main.description: Keyed by the DID of the account it names, in the organization's account, in one place: its public records for a member anyone may see; or, where its PDS has spaces, its space of type dev.knotless.org keyed self, which only its members read, for an invitation or a hidden member. The account is a member once it keeps a dev.knotless.orgAcceptance record naming the organization, in the same place, and the organization has taken it in (joinedAt); until then it is invited, until expiresAt. In a private repository's space, a member of the organization that owns it who pushes to it. One keyed other than by the DID it names names no one.

role.description: An admin also invites and removes members, changes roles and makes repositories as the organization. A value a reader does not know reads as member.
One role an organization gives a member.

description: An organization's side of its membership: an account it invited, and their roles.
